traits.desc: Has advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
traits.desc_ru: Особенность «Кеен Хеаринг и Смелл». Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell

traits.desc: Has three heads. While it has more than one head it has advantage on saves vs. being blinded charmed deafened frightened stunned and knocked unconscious. Whenever it takes 25 or more damage in a single turn one head dies. If all its heads die it dies. At the end of its turn it grows two heads for each head that died since its last turn unless it has taken fire since its last turn. Regains 10 hp for each head regrown in this way.

traits.desc: If it moves 20'+ straight toward creature and then hits it with Bite on same turn target must make a DC 16 Str save or be knocked prone. If target is prone garmvvolf can make one Bite vs. it as a bonus action.

traits.desc: While it sleeps at least one of its heads is awake.
